description: This PHP source file defines the 'Request' class, which extends Symfony's HttpRequest class to add custom request handling logic within the OrangeHRM application. It includes methods for deprecated request parameter access and creating request instances from global server variables, with specific behaviors tailored for development and plugin contexts.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: A subclass of Symfony's HttpRequest adding custom request handling logic, including deprecated getter method and global creation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overrides the parent get method to include deprecation warning in development mode and checks for plugin context to throw an exception if used internally.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a Request object from PHP's global variables, with special handling for authorization headers to support certain server configurations.
